title: High-Spectral Veil — Perception Configuration
description: Runtime toggles and tuning parameters for the High-Spectral Veil vision pipeline. Controls three primary perception modes plus anomaly detection sensitivity. Persisted to localStorage under the key 'gab:veil:perception-config'.

modes.description: Three primary perception mode toggles. Modes are additive — multiple can be active simultaneously. The composite is rendered as a blended overlay.

spiritualEntityFocus.description: Unfiltered Mode — removes all software noise-reduction and post-processing filters. Preserves raw spectral data at full precision for visual patterns that standard processing pipelines discard.

description.const: Unfiltered Mode — all post-processing suppression disabled. Raw multi-band data at full sensor precision.

lutPreset.description: LUT applied in this mode. GHOST_MODE inverts luminance for negative-space rendering.

gainBoost.description: Software gain multiplier applied uniformly to all channels. >1.0 amplifies weak signals.

channels.description: Which bands feed into this mode's composite frame.

phaseInversionAlert.description: Surface PHASE_INVERSION anomaly events on the overlay when enabled.

uapTracker.description: UAP Tracker — Multi-Spectrum Contrast mode. Highlights objects that appear in two or more non-adjacent spectral bands simultaneously, or that exhibit velocity anomalies inconsistent with aerodynamic constraints.

description.const: Multi-Spectrum Contrast — cross-band object persistence and velocity anomaly detection.

velocityThreshold.description: Normalised motion magnitude (0–1) above which VELOCITY_EXCEED fires. Lower = more sensitive.

multiBandRequirement.description: Minimum number of spectral bands in which an object must simultaneously appear to be flagged for tracking.

trackingPersistenceFrames.description: Number of frames an anomaly must persist before a stable track is declared.

highlightColor.description: CSS hex color for bounding box overlay on tracked objects.

thermalGhosting.description: Thermal Ghosting — Heat Displacement mode. Detects LWIR (thermal) signatures that are spatially or temporally displaced from their visible-spectrum counterpart — heat without a visible source, or residual thermal imprint after an object has moved.

description.const: Heat Displacement — LWIR signatures without visible-spectrum correlation, or residual thermal imprints.

thermalGhostRatio.description: LWIR/VIS mean ratio above which THERMAL_GHOST fires. Higher = less sensitive.

stationaryHeatAlert.description: Flag STATIONARY_HEAT events — elevated LWIR with zero motion vector (residual imprint).

decayFrames.description: Number of frames a thermal ghost imprint is held visible after the trigger clears.

colorMap.description: False-colour palette for the LWIR channel.

highlightColor.description: CSS hex color for thermal ghost bounding box overlays.

spectralComposition.description: Default spectral band mapping into RGB composite. Overridden per-mode when a mode is active.

overlayEnabled.description: Render bounding box overlays on the live feed for each detected anomaly.

stream.description: Live vision-sync stream configuration for glasses feed → Synology NAS.

enabled.description: Enable real-time streaming to the vision-sync service.

targetUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the vision-sync service. e.g. ws://synology-nas:5055/stream

frameRateFps.description: Target stream frame rate. Lower = less bandwidth.

bands.description: Which raw bands to include in the streamed payload alongside the composite.

agentAnalysisEnabled.description: Send each frame to the Ollama agent for real-time AI analysis on the Synology.

agentModelId.description: Ollama model ID to use for agent analysis.
